findings.highlight: There's no way Lancer or Gilgamesh will appear while the sun's still out.
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーにしろギルガメッシュにしろ、日が昇っているうちに現れる事はないだろう。
findings.governingReading: だろう marks Shirou's expectation that neither will appear while the sun is up.
findings.explanation: Expected daytime absence becomes no possibility of appearing.

findings.highlight: He has an infinite supply of Noble Phantasms, and one of them is stronger than Excalibur.
findings.evidenceJa: 無限とも言える数の宝具を持ち、その中の一つはセイバーのエクスカリバーをも上回っている。
findings.governingReading: 無限とも言える数 qualifies how the huge number may be described.
findings.explanation: An arsenal one could call infinite becomes an infinite supply.

findings.highlight: Berserker was a hard enemy to defeat, but we still managed.
findings.evidenceJa: 例えば、確かにバーサーカーは倒すのが困難な強敵だったが、たとえ劣勢でも戦いにはなったのだ。
findings.governingReading: Even outmatched, Berserker permitted a real fight and the pursuit of a potential way to reverse the pressure.
findings.explanation: Possible reversal in an actual contest becomes retrospective victory and exploitation.
